correctness.rationale: For Sp(4,q) projective point orthogonality graph, strongly regular counts show every third-vertex adjacency pattern over any ordered pair occurs, yielding FO3 equivalence. At four reusable variables an enhanced 3-pebble signature records equality, adjacency and projective collinearity; exhaustive dependent/independent triple linear-algebra extension cases show uniform reachable next-point signatures for q>=3. The q=2 graph lacks a four-clique since a totally isotropic subspace has dimension at most two with only q+1=3 projective points, while q>=3 has K4. Independent enumeration of exact enhanced extension catalogs for q2 and q3 (all triples) and q5 sampled triples (16 signatures each; 0 mismatches), plus K4 boundary, corroborates but does not prove all fields or unlimited quantifier depth.
residual_risks: An unidentified specialized finite-variable logic theorem could already imply cross-q 4-pebble equivalence.
Independent finite q5 sampling is not a full q5 or all-q proof.
